items.title: CVE-2026-60044
items.summary: The backups created by the application use a weak static password allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to access their content. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality.

items.title: CVE-2026-60040
items.summary: An unauthenticated remote attacker can perform a DoS in the backends backup creation function. This can result in a total loss of availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-60039
items.summary: A high privileged remote attacker can perform a code injection in the backends backup restore function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-60035
items.summary: A high privileged remote attacker can perform a code injection in the backends network auth function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.
